A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same LM-EEC research work, with complete readable main text, equations, figures, tables, references, and Appendices A–G. Full text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to the arXiv stamp and one acknowledgment sentence.

before.justification: v1 reports original EgoExo4D experiments, including benchmark comparisons, component ablations, and appendix experiments on video length and transfer of MV-MoE to other backbones.

after.justification: v2 retains the original EgoExo4D benchmark results, ablations, qualitative analyses, and appendix experiments reported in v1.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the identical SAM 2-based LM-EEC architecture, Memory-View MoE routing, dual memory banks, and memory compression procedure. The backbone adaptations in Appendix F are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use EgoExo4D with the same Ego2Exo and Exo2Ego tasks, activity scenarios, object-size analyses, and video-length coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains XSegTx, both XView-XMem variants, STCN, QDMN, GSFM, SimVOS, Cutie, and the base model. Comparator membership also remains identical in the compression ablation and appendix comparisons.

E3.justification: The 756/202/291 training/validation/test split, evaluation metrics, preprocessing, training budgets, and ablation settings are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same video-length groups and IoU threshold of 0.5 for association accuracy.

E4.justification: Both versions contain identical fusion, memory-bank, compression, training-frame, and memory-size ablations. Object-size and activity analyses, qualitative comparisons, failure cases, attention visualizations, long-video evaluation, and backbone-transfer experiments are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are identical. For example, Table 1 retains LM-EEC IoU values of 54.98 for Ego queries and 65.77 for Exo queries, while Appendix Table 7 retains association accuracy of 0.6150 versus the baseline's 0.4724 for videos exceeding 600 frames.

T1.justification: The task formulation, Equations (1)–(10), and mathematical definitions remain identical. No assumptions, derivations, theoretical results, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about adaptive feature fusion, compressed long-term dual memory, and state-of-the-art EgoExo4D performance.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same object-disappearance failure condition, balanced-accuracy limitation, proposed remedies, and broader-impact discussion.

D1.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendix G retain identical implementation settings, hardware, inference speed, optimizers, and training budgets. The code and model availability statements and access link are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, reference list, and positioning relative to SAM 2 and earlier segmentation methods are identical.

P1.justification: The page 9 acknowledgment changes from stating that Heng Fan received no funding to stating that Heng Fan and Dongfang Liu received no funding. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10 and Tables 1–9 retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. Page layout and pagination are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 extends the funding acknowledgment to Dongfang Liu and updates the arXiv stamp. The scientific content, empirical evidence, limitations, reproducibility information, and appendices are identical, so the limited disclosure refinement does not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
